passages.title: Leadership survey reminder · Document 1
passages.text: Mandatory {{1}} in the leadership survey begins Monday. It asks about communication and scheduling. Responses will be {{2}}, and only summaries will be shared. {{3}} Participants completing it by Wednesday receive early {{4}} to the coaching toolkit.

passages.title: Returnable box collection · Document 1
passages.text:
Dear customers,

Our reusable boxes can be {{1}} at either collection point. Please empty them {{2}} bringing them back; staff will carry out the sanitizing process. A deposit is refunded only when the returned box has been {{3}} against its issue record. {{4}}

passages.title: Cafeteria mobile orders · Document 1
passages.text: The cafeteria will introduce mobile ordering on Monday. Staff can place an order {{1}} arriving. Once it has been {{2}}, the app will display an estimated collection time. {{3}}, payment confirmation alone does not mean that the meal is ready. Wait for the separate ready-to-collect notice. {{4}}

passages.title: Question Ocean · P6-G34 · Document 1
passages.text:
To: Procurement Team
From: Contract Compliance
Subject: Supplier Renewal Checks

Before extending any supplier agreement, procurement staff must verify that the vendor has {{1}} all required insurance certificates. If a certificate is due to expire within sixty days, the vendor should submit an updated copy {{2}} the renewal is approved. {{3}} This additional review prevents a contract from being extended while essential coverage is inactive. Staff members who identify a discrepancy should record it in the contract portal and {{4}} the legal team immediately.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R26 · Document 1
passages.text:
Facilities Scheduling Assistant

Riverton University seeks an assistant to coordinate classroom reservations and maintain event calendars. The position requires excellent organizational skills and familiarity with spreadsheet software. Previous experience in an educational institution is preferred. The selected candidate will work from 8 A.M. to 4 P.M., Monday through Friday. Applications must include a résumé and a cover letter.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R23 · Document 1
passages.text: The Downtown Art Walk will take place on the evening of May 18. More than twenty galleries will remain open until 10 P.M., and a free shuttle will operate between participating locations. Printed maps can be collected at the visitor center beginning at 4 P.M. Some workshops require advance registration, although admission to the galleries is free.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R10 · Document 1
passages.text:
BrightPath Language Center
Summer Business English Intensive

Improve presentation, negotiation, and e-mail writing skills in four weeks. Classes meet Monday through Thursday from 6:30 to 8:30 P.M. All course materials are included. Register by May 20 to receive a ten percent early-registration discount. A free placement interview is required before the first class.

passages.title: Community solar information · Document 1
passages.text:
SOLAR INFORMATION EVENING
The council's event will compare rooftop-solar options for residents. Presenters will explain typical costs and questions to ask installers, but they will not provide a binding quotation for an individual property. Roof condition, shading, and electrical arrangements need a site-specific assessment. Attendance is free, and no purchase is required. Residents should treat examples as illustrations rather than guaranteed savings for every household.

passages.title: Return delivery labels · Document 1
passages.text:
RETURN LABEL NOTICE
A prepaid return label is valid for one parcel only. If an order arrived in two cartons, contact support before returning both; copying the same label onto a second carton can cause tracking and billing errors. Pack accessories with the item they belong to and retain proof of handover. A label being generated does not mean the carrier has collected the parcel or that a refund has already been approved.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R03 · Document 1
passages.text: Northstar Electronics announced yesterday that it will open a research center in Taichung early next year. The facility will focus on energy-efficient sensors for household appliances. According to Chief Executive Mina Ross, the location was selected because of its access to engineering talent and nearby manufacturing partners. The company expects to hire approximately 120 employees during the center's first year of operation.

passages.title: Temporary reception duties · Document 1
passages.text:
To: Front-desk cover staff
During the renovation, greet visitors at the temporary desk but do not issue building-access cards yourself. Security will verify identity and activate the cards. You may record arrival and contact the host while that check takes place. If the host cannot be reached, visitors should remain in the waiting area. The temporary location changes where we greet people, not the authorization needed to enter controlled areas.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R04 · Document 1
passages.text:
Dear Customer Service,

I ordered a standing desk from your website on May 3. The desk arrived yesterday, but one of the metal legs was damaged and the assembly instructions were missing. I have attached photographs of the damaged part. Please send a replacement leg and a copy of the instructions as soon as possible. My order number is SD-7741.

Sincerely,
Kevin Wu

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R58 · Document 1
passages.text:
Announcement

The Weston Public Library will extend its weekday hours during the final two weeks of May to support students preparing for certification exams. From May 18 to May 29, the study rooms on the second floor will remain open until 10 P.M. Reservations are required for groups of three or more, but individual students may use any open seat without reserving.

To keep the extended hours quiet and useful, food deliveries will not be allowed after 8 P.M., and phone calls must be taken in the lobby. Library staff will provide extra charging cables at the information desk, but laptops are not available for loan during the evening schedule.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R87 · Document 1
passages.text:
Course Announcement

Participants in next month's public-speaking course should complete the online questionnaire by June 3. The instructor will use the responses to divide participants into groups with similar goals. Those who want extra practice with visual aids should bring a short slide deck to the first session. The course office will provide laptops and projectors, but participants must bring their own adapters if their computers require them. A final practice presentation will be recorded for private review only.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R92 · Document 1
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 1 — CLEARLINE VOICE STUDIO

Give callers a polished first impression with a professionally recorded telephone greeting. Our services include professional voice talent, customized on-hold messages, script editing, and multilingual production. Visit our online portfolio to compare voices, speaking styles, and accents. Send an inquiry with your contact information and project requirements, and a representative will respond within one business day with scheduling options and an estimate.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R92 · Document 2
passages.text:
DOCUMENT 2 — E-MAIL

From: Priya Raman, Director, Harbor Health Clinic
To: ClearLine Voice Studio
Subject: Bilingual telephone greeting

I saw your listing in the Westside Business Newsletter and am interested in a new greeting for my clinic. I already have a finalized script, so I need recording rather than writing assistance. The greeting should be recorded by one calm, neutral-sounding voice in both English and Mandarin. We do not need an on-hold message at this time. Please call me between 1:00 and 4:00 P.M. to discuss available speakers and your production schedule.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R69 · Document 1
passages.text:
Press Release

Lumen Transit will add real-time crowding information to its train app next month. The feature will estimate how full each train car is using weight sensors and recent boarding data.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R69 · Document 2
passages.text:
FAQ

Does the app identify individual passengers?
No. The system estimates crowding levels and does not collect names, ticket numbers, or phone locations.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R69 · Document 3
passages.text:
Customer E-mail

To: Lumen Transit Support
From: Jordan Wells
Subject: Accessibility Question

I use a wheelchair and usually board the first car because it has a wider space near the door. Will the new crowding feature show information for each car separately, or only for the whole train? If it only shows the whole train, it may not help passengers like me choose the most accessible car.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R59 · Document 1
passages.text:
Notice

The GreenLine Bike-Share Program will replace the payment kiosks at Central Station on Monday. During the replacement, riders may unlock bicycles only through the GreenLine mobile app. The work is expected to finish by 4 P.M.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R59 · Document 2
passages.text:
Customer Message

To: GreenLine Support
From: Dana Kim
Subject: Monday Rental

I plan to rent two bicycles at Central Station at 10 A.M. Monday for visitors from our overseas office. One visitor does not have a smartphone. If the kiosks will be unavailable, can I reserve two bicycles in advance or pick them up from another nearby station? We need to reach the museum before our 11 A.M. tour.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R42 · Document 1
passages.text:
E-MAIL
From: Jordan Lee, Northstar Office Supply
To: Priya Raman, Lakeside Dental
Subject: Revised Delivery Schedule

Ms. Raman,
Thank you for your patience while we adjusted the delivery schedule for your examination chairs. The shipment that was delayed at the regional warehouse has now been released. Our driver will arrive on Tuesday between 8 A.M. and 10 A.M. A technician will return on Wednesday morning to complete the installation.

passages.title: Question Ocean · P7-R42 · Document 2
passages.text:
TEXT MESSAGE
Priya Raman: Will the technician need access to the storage room?
Jordan Lee: Yes. Please leave the labeled hardware boxes there. The technician will also inspect the electrical outlet before installing the chairs.

passages.text:

passages.text:
